data.narrative:
Rocket Lab is a publicly traded Space & Aerospace company founded by Peter Beck. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 3 same-sector, same-stage public peers: Planet Labs ($7.6B), Firefly Aerospace ($2.9B), and Astroscale ($840M). An additional 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private companies inform sector context.

The Peer-Median method is the applicable triangulation approach. The median valuation across the 3 public comparables is $2.9B, with a range spanning $840M at the low end (Astroscale) to $7.6B at the high end (Planet Labs). Public-Comp Anchoring using sector P/S multiples—which median 25.3x across 6 Space & Aerospace tickers—cannot be applied due to absence of revenue data on file for the target.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.5B to $3.3B, centered on $2.9B implied by peer median. The current stated valuation of approximately $40B sits substantially above this range. Key uncertainties include revenue visibility and margin trajectory relative to peers, as well as the wide dispersion within the comparable set ($840M to $7.6B), which reflects heterogeneity in asset mix and profitability across Space & Aerospace operators. The single-method result suggests limited triangulation power; additional valuation approaches would strengthen conviction.
